ticks.note: Tick 1 enters `Control`; the self-loop is delayed, so the code effect has not run yet: `heater` is false.
17 is below 18: the `if` branch switches `heater` on.
20 is neither below 18 nor above 22: the `else` branch runs, its inner `if` does not, and `heater` keeps its value, true.
20 again, and `heater` stays off: between 18 and 22 the thermostat keeps what it last did.
